lines: Manish Sharma, Promoter Selling Shareholder, receives money by selling up to 45,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹6.08 crore in proceeds, if all offered shares are sold; in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 249 days ago.
Retained shares, an estimated ₹110.73 crore at offer price, unlock in part since 9 Sep 2026, with the rest locked until 9 Sep 2027.
Sibling-style family link: Priyanka Manish Sharma shares the name Manish Sharma, so check for a related holding.
